# ITD System Architecture Monitoring and Updates

This document details the necessary actions for maintaining system integrity and performance within the IT & Digital department.

*   We need to investigate the firewall settings quarterly.
*   We need to investigate the API latency urgently.
*   We need to monitor the firewall settings standard update.
*   We need to monitor the API latency standard update.
*   We need to update the firewall settings quarterly.
